failure: Encircled or cut off behind the front: Somaliland and Jubaland lost once their armies left; Afar and Wello retaken behind the army
prevention: Guard roles for every border state; never remove guards (revision invariant); corridor rule; hold_targets

failure: All Eritrean provinces lost in the Christmas offensive
prevention: Hook extraction finds the 14-day ETH bonus; phase P1 hold with guards on every border province

failure: Building on fronts or in low infrastructure
prevention: Construction lint: no factory within K province steps of an enemy border; infrastructure >= 3 or infrastructure queued first

failure: Random far-future research: artillery2-5, legacy air, a non-existent key
prevention: research_fallback off or restricted with prefixes; research_path validation and lint (start years, prerequisites)

failure: Wrong win condition: Addis province instead of state 271; wrong Conquer Ethiopia timing
prevention: Goal predicates from the scenario hooks; mandatory control states in vp_targets; deadline from the scenario timer; critic row 1

failure: Supply starvation: 1.4% and 9% supply, hubs queued behind factories
prevention: Supply order: (1) railway levels (cheap) on the target route from existing or captured hubs and ports; (2) where no supply reaches a shore near the front, a new port or port level (naval_base 5000 + 1000 per level) on a coastal province owned or controlled, with free convoys at 0.25 per supply point and a sea route the enemy does not block; (3) motorisation and a truck line from day 1; (4) a supply_node only when calc.py build-order shows it finishes before it is needed and no port or railway extension serves the same provinces; supply_first; supply_floor; a supply-capacity cap on strike army size

failure: Armies scattered by stall moves; one 18-division army over 7 states
prevention: Concentration in the layout; vp_targets per army; stall backoff (already in the executor)

failure: Duplicate and failing actions repeated
prevention: Validated keys; executor memory keyed by stable ids; failure ledger

failure: Player too slow: one turn spans 10-30 game days
prevention: Executor owns more domains; the brief is short and procedural; player items name the exact tool call

failure: Mission timers ignored
prevention: Missions with timers in the dossier; checkpoints at mission deadlines; goal deadline equal to the scenario timer

failure: No equipment at the front
prevention: Disband home divisions early; calc equipment; training stockpile guard; production lines that fit the military factories and use unlocked equipment

failure: Day-1 or wartime supply hubs (base cost 20000) cannot finish in a short war; they starved the factory build-up in the hand plans
prevention: Railways first, then a port where no supply reaches the shore (a quarter of a hub's cost, higher initial flow 3.3 vs 2.8, weeks to build), then trucks; a supply_node only after calc.py build-order shows its finish date (about 190-270 days with 15 civilian factories at infrastructure 2 to 0, longer under a construction-speed malus) is before the date it is needed and no port or railway can serve; every construction item states its cost in points, its estimated finish date and the source

failure: Offensives executed the tick after the lines were drawn, so they fought at about 0% planning; the stall fallback's direct moves burned the rest (3% a day under manual orders) and left flanks open
prevention: Wait war.plan_days (12-15 game days, planning to 30%) after drawing a front and offensive line before executing, unless the enemy is about to dig in or a deadline is under 20 days; a general with a deployed HQ on every attacking army; at a stall rest if supply or org is under 50%, else replan the offensive on the next target with two attack directions; a direct move only into an empty adjacent province with a guard behind

failure: Armies kept attacking at 25-50% supply: attrition starts at 35%, and an attacker out of supply loses 25% attack and 65% defence, so offensives bled and stalled
prevention: war.supply_floor 50 (no new offensive below it); below 35% stop and pull 25-50% of the divisions out of the overdrawn province; resume at 70%; split an army whose province is overdrawn on two reads

failure: The pocket fall-back fired at 70% hostile share around the army, after the neck had closed; encircled armies get no manpower, equipment or fuel and their HQ general is captured
prevention: Fall back at 50% hostile share or when the neck to the army's rear is 2 own provinces or fewer; the HQ goes first; a pinning attack on the unit that would close the neck; corridor guards behind any strike leg longer than 2 provinces

failure: Strike armies pushed on past captured hubs before the captured railway connected (10 days, 5 on cores) and starved at the spear
prevention: Advance in bounds: after taking a state with a hub or port, or 2 states past the last own hub, rest until the node connects (about 8-12 days) while the railway into it is queued at the top; the rest rebuilds planning

failure: A mature rifle or tank line was switched to the next tier at once: a tier switch keeps 30% of efficiency and cancels the unit in progress, so output collapsed while the old gear was still needed
prevention: Per tier change in the research path: start the new model on new or idle factories (3-5, about 10% of the old line) and keep the old line until its gear covers about 30 days of field demand or quality binds, then switch the old line whole; variants (90%) any time; finish an expensive unit in progress first

failure: Start lines the plan never used (fighters, interwar CAS, tankettes, light tanks, capital ships) kept factories and dockyards busy for months
prevention: Line audit at the start and at every phase change: every line is kept, resized or removed with a reason; a line no template, wing, fleet or stockpile target uses is removed; naval lines finish the hull in progress first (production[].remove with from)

failure: Free military factories were assigned after the first unpause, so they started new lines at 10% instead of joining the start lines at their efficiency (Germany left 8 factories idle)
prevention: Day-0 production step while still paused: every free or freed military factory onto an existing start line the plan keeps; removals only move factories to other existing lines

failure: Every idle military factory was poured into the first matching priority line at once; moved factories restart at 10% and other items ran short
prevention: Idle factories go to the line with the fewest days of cover in chunks of max(2, 20% of the line); pull factories only from a line with 90+ days of cover to one under 7 days, at most one pull per line per 30 days and never more than 20% of a line

failure: 20-21 wide line divisions (and 34-40 wide assaults) planned for mountain and hill fronts, where they fill the battle width badly
prevention: Width from the axis terrain: line divisions 14-18 for mountains and hills, 20 elsewhere; mountaineers 25 or less; no 34-36 or 40+ outside plains

failure: The manpower rule stepped conscription automatically; Service by Requirement and higher cost 10-40% factory, dockyard and construction output that the plan did not need
prevention: Plan only the conscription law the manpower plan needs (divisions x manpower + 2 months of losses); a higher law only when training is blocked by manpower or the front is under 80% manpower; manage.conscription_laws lists the allowed laws

failure: Invasions planned on a 14-day preparation; the game needs 60 days less 10 per transport tech, caps divisions and plans by tech, and never starts an invasion for an army that still has front orders
prevention: Preparation and caps from the techs owned (4/1/60, transport 6/2/50, landing craft 10/5/40, tank landing craft 15/9/30); detach the invasion divisions into an army with no front or fallback line; 60% control and 40% naval intel on every route region at launch

failure: The plan edited start templates marked obsolete (decommissioned) or is_locked in the history OOB; the game shows no Edit button for them, so 7 of 8 template changes failed and the widened colonial divisions never existed
prevention: Edit only templates without obsolete or is_locked; for a decommissioned or locked start template create a new template under another name and train or convert into it (validate_plan errors on such a base)
